sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing, causing an entire chain of operations to collapse into Nothing if any single step fails.
sketches.resonance: One absence anywhere poisons everything that follows — the way a single loss can hollow out an entire future.
sketches.draft:
whereDidYouGo :: Maybe a
whereDidYouGo = do
  morning   <- Just ()
  afternoon <- Just ()
  you       <- Nothing
  evening   <- Just ()
  return evening

sketches.mechanism: A generator function with yield that is never iterated — the function body never executes, the values are never produced, the work is never witnessed.
sketches.resonance: A life full of things to give, but no one ever asks — the offering exists only as suspended potential.
sketches.draft:
def everything_i_wanted_to_show_you():
    yield 1954
    yield 1955
    yield 1956
    yield 1957
    yield 1958

unwitnessed = everything_i_wanted_to_show_you()

sketches.mechanism: The `lateinit` modifier promises a variable will be initialized before use but provides no guarantee — accessing it before initialization throws UninitializedPropertyAccessException at runtime.
sketches.resonance: Some things we declare we will eventually be ready for, but the moment arrives and we are still empty.
